collapse.name: The collapse
collapse.text: (Patient) collapses in the village center. (patient.His/Her) breath is faint, (patient.his/her) skin cold, and the healers say that (patient.he/she) is dying NOW. The gathered villagers must decide what to do before time runs out.

text_only.reason: the villager collapses; no structure is involved

a2.text: A Life Forever Changed: (Patient) survives with lasting weakness and breathlessness; (patient.he/she) develops a dislike of running.

text_only.reason: rule 9: no lasting weakness state; the dislike of running is the game's own preference

a3.text: One Last Conversation: Consciousness returns just long enough for (Patient) to speak final words to a loved one, then (patient.he/she) dies.

a4.text: The Unanswered Question: (Patient) dies despite the healers' efforts.

b1.text: The Forest's Mercy: Flowers open around (Patient), whose breathing returns; (patient.he/she) recovers completely.

b2.text: Rooted Between Worlds: Living roots enclose the motionless patient in suspended animation. Days later (patient.he/she) awakens, weak but alive.

text_only.reason: rule 9: told, the villager simply stays as they are

b3.text: The Price of Renewal: (Patient) survives but suffers enduring sensitivity to heat, sunlight, and exertion.

b4.text: Nature Reclaims Its Own: Flowers bloom, but (Patient) dies.

c1.text: The Impossible Revival: Light surrounds the patient; (Patient) rises briefly from the ground and awakens fully healed.

c2.text: The Sleeping Miracle: Magic suspends the decline, leaving (Patient) motionless until a later awakening.

text_only.reason: rule 9: no suspended state; told only

c3.text: The Broken Spell: Breathing returns, but intermittent weakness and strange sensations persist.

c4.text: The Price of Power: The ritual fails and (Patient) dies.

d1.text: The Ancestors Answer: (Patient) awakens and describes familiar voices calling (patient.him/her) back; the village celebrates.

d2.text: A Final Blessing: (Patient) briefly awakens to give a blessing and then dies. The words enter the village's oral history.

d3.text: The Long Vigil: The patient lies in a deathlike stillness until sunrise, then awakens.

text_only.reason: a partial recovery is a lasting state no game has (rule 9); the villager awakens as the text says

d4.text: Silence from Beyond: The prayers continue, but (Patient) dies.

e1.text: The Apprentice's Miracle: An apprentice improvises a rescue with available supplies and skilled guidance; (Patient) fully recovers.

e2.text: Saved, But Not Unscathed: (Patient) survives with limited stamina and a permanent dislike of running.

e3.text: A Narrow Escape: The improvised effort buys time for a master healer to stabilize (Patient).

text_only.reason: a partial recovery is a lasting state no game has (rule 9)

e4.text: The Cost of Desperation: The attempt fails; (Patient) dies.

f1.text: The Unnatural Survivor: (Patient) awakens with cold skin and a barely detectable heartbeat. Some call (patient.him/her) a miracle; others call (patient.him/her) an abomination.

f2.text: The Walking Dead: Movement returns but awareness seems absent. (Patient) wanders and responds faintly to familiar voices. The village debates whether this is life at all.

text_only.reason: rule 9: no such state; told only

f3.text: The Miracle They Condemned: (Patient) recovers fully, but the healer who saved (patient.him/her) is accused of violating sacred laws.

f4.text: The Forbidden Failure: (Patient) dies; the healer faces a public hearing over the forbidden intervention.

f5.text: The Patient Who Remembered Death: (Patient) survives and claims to recall dying, causing scholarly and spiritual controversy.

text_only.reason: the villager survives; the death is remembered, not happening

g2.text: The Long Road Back: Survival comes with permanent limitations and dislike of running.

g3.text: The Living Sleeper: The patient enters suspended animation; days later (patient.he/she) awakens.

text_only.reason: rule 9: no suspended state or partial recovery

g4.text: The Last Words: (Patient) regains consciousness briefly, says goodbye, and dies.

g5.text: The Uncertain Victory: (Patient) survives, but the healers cannot tell whether their intervention was responsible.

a1_h.text: The Physician's Triumph: Careful treatment stabilizes (Patient); (patient.he/she) eventually recovers fully.

a1_n.text: The Physician's Triumph: Careful treatment stabilizes (Patient); (patient.he/she) eventually recovers fully.

text_only.reason: no healer is cast in this village (the role is optional), so nobody gains it
